region.finding: All 13 original animations visually inspected in complete front and side body and head sheets. Serval cheeks and lower muzzle shear during strike and defeat. Bind-coordinate raycasts locate the crystals behind z=.37; repair now fades in only beyond z=.42 to preserve all back crystals and their original weights.
